title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
about: In a retro-futuristic 1960s New York, the Fantastic Four face Galactus while Sue and Reed await their first child.
cue: Serve the mains when the family sits down together at the Baxter Building.
faces: Serve the mains when the family sits down together at the Baxter Building.
